2950.translation: Breaking news: City reduce centre speed limit to 40 km/h from next month. For major city-centre roads, limit go fall from 50 to 40 kilometres per hour. City say pedestrian accidents reduce during trial. After six months, dem go analyse effect again before deciding whether to extend am to other roads.

2951.translation: Employment figures improve, but young people situation no move

2952.translation: Dem raise target for cutting carbon emissions

2954.translation: City education office announce say from next semester, primary-school after-class care go last till 7 p.m.

2955.translation: News opening sentence usually end with plain -다 forms like 밝혔다, 분석했다 and 기록했다. Source attribution use -다고 밝혔다 or -다고 분석했다.

2956.translation: Experts analyse say this measure alone no go easily reduce the price increase.

2957.translation: Because semiconductor sales strong, last month exports reach highest level for that month.

2958.translation: Roundup: Evening library opening go expand; users satisfied well. City say satisfaction with this year public-library evening trial high. Most respondents say borrowing books after work convenient. Based on this, city plan add ten more evening-opening libraries next year.

2959.translation: Newspaper use headline say effect of youth startup grants don get proof. But body say recipients one-year business survival rate only 2 percentage points above comparison group. Researchers also say sample small and hard to generalise. Headline therefore make stronger claim than cautious body conclusion.

2960.translation: Question headlines dey more common. People defend am say e cautious because e no assert unconfirmed facts. But headline like Subsidy: e go work? fit leave negative impression even when body no answer. E fit quietly pass claim through question form. Readers often skim only headline, so dem no correct impression. Question headline justified only if body provide grounds for the question.

2961.translation: As breaking-news competition grow, unconfirmed information often enter headlines. Readers want quick news, so speed itself no bad. But later correction no easily erase first headline impression, because fewer people read corrections. Conflict between speed and accuracy no justify shortening verification. Publishing confirmed facts, even late, na how to keep trust.

2962.translation: Headline saying bicycle accidents double quickly attract attention. Putting change rate first fit compress information well. But if starting number small, double tell little: one case becoming two fit get same headline. Hundreds doubling get very different weight. When headline use change rate, body must give original count so readers fit judge scale.

2963.translation: Quotation marks for headline fit make report look objective. Dem useful for relaying exact words. But choosing only most provocative word from long statement na editing choice, no be neutral delivery. Quotation marks no guarantee accuracy; dem fit show selection. Readers should check body to see how quoted words relate to context.

2964.translation: News often put main point first for inverted-pyramid structure. Readers fit get gist even if dem stop early. But for complex issue, only putting conclusion first push conditions and counterarguments back, so early-only readers get oversimple understanding. Plenty readers no reach end; na weakness of this structure. Better to summarise first but include the most important condition too.

2965.translation: Headline saying consumer prices slow fit make reader think prices fall. Economic-news readers fit know say na rate of increase reduce. But no be everybody know that. If prices remain high while headline stress slowing, e fit create optimism wey differ from people experience. Before shortening technical expression, check whether readers share the same background meaning.

2966.translation: Controversy na common headline word. E useful to briefly show matter wey opinions divide on. But dem sometimes attach am to criticism from few people or weak suspicions, making am look like whole society split. One word enlarge matter. If dem use am, body must show clearly who dey disagree about wetin.

2967.translation: Government decide increase research-and-development investment for next year budget proposal compared with this year.

2968.translation: Report say household debt fall for first time on record for this year third quarter.

2969.translation: Union no fit settle wage differences with management, so e decide to vote on strike.

2970.translation: City authorities dey consider suspending firms wey pass water-quality limits.

2971.translation: Exports grow, but domestic demand shrink, so recovery slow.

2972.translation: Research team say dem need test results again with bigger sample.

2973.translation: This amendment start work six months after official publication.

2974.translation: Film pass one million viewers just three days after release and cause strong box-office wave.

2975.translation: Newspaper headline call unemployment jump crisis sign. This month unemployment rate rise 0.3 percentage points to 3.4 percent. But Employment Trends Institute say survey use sample households, with error range of plus or minus 0.4 percentage points. Change inside that range hard to separate from sampling chance. So even with exact figures for body, jump for headline stronger than figures allow. Better to check several months flow instead of one-month movement.

2976.translation: For new-town development poll, support na 48 percent and opposition na 45 percent. Broadcaster report say support dey lead. Sampling error na plus or minus 3.1 percentage points at 95 percent confidence. The 3-point gap inside error range no establish which side larger statistically. Saying opinions nearly equal more faithful to data. Turning raw number order directly into ranking fit make readers take am as settled fact.

2977.translation: Local paper say bicycle accidents double. Body show rise from 3 last year to 6 this year, a 100 percent increase. But small total mean even one or two chance cases change ratio plenty. Meanwhile, motor accidents for same area rise 5 percent, from 1,200 to 1,260, without headline. Which risk readers need know most? Headline ratio no directly show importance.

2978.translation: Bar chart show Region A rent more than twice Region B height. But vertical axis no start at 0; e start at 800,000 won. Real rents na 920,000 won for A and 850,000 won for B, just over 8 percent apart. Cutting off starting point make small gap look big. Even if chart shape seem to support article, readers need check scale and units to avoid visual deception.

2979.translation: Weather phrase highest temperature since records begin need care. Onsaemi observatory start records for 1998. So its ranking cover only some twenty years, no be same as stations wey record for nearly century. Also, if surrounding area become more urban and hold heat, local environment change fit join climate change as cause. Phrase fit true without directly proving climate change.

2980.translation: Headline say food additive A raise cancer risk. But researcher for body only say high-dose mouse experiments show more tumours in some cases, so human risk no yet ruled out. That statement no mean human risk don get confirmation. Headline remove the conditions possibility and mouse experiment, leaving only conclusion. Quoting words no mean the caution follow the quote.

2981.translation: Readers see headline average office-worker salary 52 million won and worry say their income low. But same survey table give median of 41 million won. Average being over 10 million above median mean few high earners pull average upward. For uneven data like income, average fit fail represent ordinary people. Headline number no wrong, but indicator choice cause plenty of the worry.

2982.translation: E risky to judge whole article from headline alone.

2983.translation: When quoting figures, mention survey organisation and date too.

2984.translation: Headlines often shorten content to catch attention.

2985.translation: E only repeat announcement without checking whether e true.

2986.translation: If you talk kindly to others, dem go talk kindly to you.

2987.translation: Your friend dey snap at everybody, then complain say people rude to am.

2988.translation: Proverbs na fixed sayings wey give general lesson through figurative meaning. Dem normally used as whole expressions without much change.

2989.translation: Watch wetin you talk; person fit dey listen.

2990.translation: You wan gossip about workmate for quiet office corner.

2991.translation: Talk about person, and the person go appear.

2992.translation: You just dey talk about friend, and the friend enter door.

2993.translation: When powerful people fight, innocent bystanders suffer.

2994.translation: Two big companies dey fight price war, and small suppliers dey suffer.

2996.translation: Famous chef burn food, and workers surprise.

2997.translation: Habits wey start for childhood fit last throughout life.

2998.translation: You tell parent why teaching small pikin manners early important.

2999.translation: Plenty small amounts fit join become something big.
